limits: Controlled fault fixtures are not evidence that live production data was malicious or corrupted.
Eight-surface replay uses the retained feed commit, not fresh external probes. Six drifted inputs were reconciled only in a copy.
No source feed, production ledger, scheduler, signing key, model weights or training data was changed.
Atomic replacement is per file, not a multi-file database transaction; an I/O interruption may require check/rerun.
The local advisory lock and pre-write snapshot check do not replace the repository single-writer protocol.
Canonical event is unsigned and partial; no GSPC admission, human approval or independent certification.
Protected merge and owner-controlled production/signing steps remain separate from source qualification.
Rows owned by the bare-key ledger writer are delegated/unverified, including reported payload differences; this fold cannot certify them or rewrite them.

Nineteen historical atoms missing signature/state metadata are byte-preserved only when staged source, destination and ledger payload already agree; absence is not a signature or an unsigned admission.
V1 narrow CI passed but the full repository producer gate failed. V2 full CI status must be observed on the exact updated commit.
